en.sayed-ali-raza: I have come to know of your strictness with Banū Tamīm [1] and your harshness over them.
Banū Tamīm are those that if one star sets another one rises for them.
They were never exceeded in (the art of) war in pre-Islamic times or after Islam.
They have a special kinship with us and a particular relationship.
We shall be rewarded if we pay heed to the kinship and be deemed sinful if we disregard it.
